property_summary: After a successful first call to SetLogFile by any actor, the contract always accepts a subsequent SetLogFile call (returns without revert) for any new target address on the correct contract; the mutant permanently locks the reentrancy guard so a second SetLogFile call will revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Make the reentrancy guard permanently lock by setting locked_ = true and never releasing it (first call succeeds, subsequent calls, including other functions, will revert), which can change whether SetLogFile later succeeds.
